# FDG4016

> DO use static classes sparingly.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.5 Static Class Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

How sparingly to use static classes is a design judgment; not machine-checkable.

## From the book

Static classes should be used only as supporting classes for the object-oriented core of the framework.
